businesses.business: Cloud fax and secure document exchange

offering_description.value: Sells cloud fax and secure document exchange to healthcare organizations, other businesses, government agencies and individuals. Its hosted software sends and receives faxes without fax machines, connects with clinical systems, extracts data from documents and supports electronic signatures.

primary_products.value: Cloud fax software; healthcare interoperability software; document data extraction software; electronic signature software

primary_services.value: Hosted fax transmission and reception; secure health information exchange

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, medical practices, insurers, financial institutions, law firms and other businesses; B2C: Individuals who send and receive faxes online; B2G: Government agencies that exchange sensitive documents

end_markets.value: Healthcare; financial services and insurance; legal services; government; consumer communications

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring plans for cloud fax, document exchange and electronic signatures; transaction or usage fees: Fax pages beyond plan allowances

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Processes faxes, documents and clinical data for healthcare organizations, businesses, agencies and individuals; service provider: Routes inbound and outbound faxes for organizations and individuals

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Cloud fax, healthcare interoperability, document data extraction and electronic signatures

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving healthcare organizations and other enterprise accounts; online: Self-service signup on company websites for individuals and small businesses; partners / resellers: Resellers and technology partners that integrate fax into business and clinical systems

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA requirements for handling protected health information and GDPR requirements for processing personal data
